title: Expandability
description: Library mod that provides increased control over vanilla effects and abilities
body:
ExpandAbility is a library mod that provides a couple of events to control vanilla player abilities.

Currently implemented abilities/effects:

- Swimming: swim outside fluids or disable swimming in fluids
- Walking on fluids

Planned abilities/effects:

- Permanent status effects

Mod authors: ExpandAbility is available on my maven repository: https://maven.florens.be
